extracted.name: Homemade yakisoba sauce
extracted.description: Enjoy this versatile sauce with veg, meat, seafood or noodles – it can be mixed together in minutes
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce or vegan alternative
1 tbsp oyster sauce (vegan if needed) or brown sauce
instruction_lines: Put all the ingredients in an airtight jar or container, then mix well until combined – stir together using a spoon first, then put the lid on and shake until everything is fully incorporated. Will keep chilled for up to a month.
